Message:
Ever since I was little,
getting yelled at by my parents
was just another part of my day.

But then again,
why wouldn’t they?
Anything I tried to do
would always end in failure,
and I caused nothing but trouble.

“Damn it, damn it all!
I break my back climbing
the ranks to High Priest,

and now it’s all
been for nothing
thanks to this brat!”

In times like these,
I would play with the “fairies.”

They were tiny lights
that only I could see.
And whenever I made a wish,
they’d twinkle brightly,
or happily flutter around me.

That’s how I’d spend
most of my days—
playing alone in
the corner of my room.

“There you go again,
muttering to yourself like a creep!

All of our troubles are
’cause of crap like that!
Do you get me,
you demon-possessed freak?!

I hope you do,
’cause you’re better off dead!!”

The fairies were
my only friends,
and they were the only ones
who were ever kind to me.
